'''Matt Wehner''' (DeckTech handle '''Tasa''')<ref name="dt-23962">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23962 Good PunJab Hunting], DeckTech (matt "Tasa" wehner, 16 June 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/23962/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/23962/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009100028/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23962/ Wayback Machine].</ref> played the [[2013 Texas Mini Worlds]].<ref name="pc-rem">[https://starwarsccg.org/phocadownload/2013/2013TMWDay1.pdf 2013 Texas Mini Worlds], starwarsccg.org</ref> He posted a [[Light]] [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|Hidden Base]] list on DeckTech (''Good PunJab Hunting'') and a [[Dark]] [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|Court Of The Vile Gangster]] list (''Court Of the Vile Gangsta - Limp Bizkit Style'').<ref name="dt-23843">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23843 Court Of the Vile Gangsta - Limp Bizkit Style], DeckTech (matt "Tasa" wehner, 9 June 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/23843/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/23843/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009113254/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/23843/ Wayback Machine].</ref>
